name: Emergence
desc: Phase-locked double one octave below the voice, own formants, 6 dB under the lead, centred

refs.why: an octave-below component follows the sung chorus line note for note, centred

notes: The reference: formants kept so the double stays a voice; −6 dB is the listening-test setting of 2026-11-13. Put a de-esser and gate before it
